review_text: The crust is thin and crispy, and the sauce tastes fresh. Best plain slice I've had in a while.
Staff were friendly and quick to refill our drinks. The pepperoni pizza was excellent.
Great pizza with plenty of cheese. We waited about 25 minutes for a table on Friday night, but the food made up for it.

Our server was attentive and made great recommendations. Loved the margherita.
Solid pizza and a cozy atmosphere. Service was a little slow at lunch.
